items.name: Momentum-in-US-Treasury-Bond-ETFs
items.description: In this notebook, we will analyse a pattern in treasury bond prices. This pattern produces a significant average returns which increases with maturity. Momentum can be attributed to an increase in investor demand for treasuries due to window dressing and portfolio rebalancing.

items.name: Algorithmic-Trading-The-Low-Volatility-Momentum-Rotator-L-VMR-
items.description: This project implements a rule-based, low-turnover trading strategy for Swedish large-cap equities. The strategy rotates between a concentrated basket of OMXS30 constituents and a defensive risk-off asset (cash or a bond ETF) using a simple market regime filter.

items.name: Global-Momentum-Rebalancing-GEM-Strategy-with-Monthly-Biweekly-Rotation
items.description: Global Equity Momentum (GEM) — Automated Backtests Two Python scripts implement GEM-style strategies with different rebalancing: gem_1month.py (monthly) and gem_2weeks.py (biweekly). Explore how rebalancing frequency affects performance, drawdowns, and robustness across global equity and bond ETFs.

items.name: Fortran-code-for-Br2-bond-breaking-SCTS-simulations
items.description: This program code package is used to simulate photoelectron momentum distributions from tunnel ionization of dissociating Br2 molecule. The algorithm is basing on Semiclassical Two Step (SCTS) model. And the simulated system includes the full states of Br2 bond-breaking: the ground Br2 molecule, bond breaking state (BBS), and the ground Br atom.

items.name: Regime-Aware-trading-strategy
items.description: A volatility-aware allocation that blends cross-sectional momentum, regression-based spread trading, and a defensive bond/gold sleeve. A rolling logistic classifier trained on VIX features determines how much capital is deployed in each sleeve while a risk overlay keeps portfolio volatility bounded.

items.name: Cross-Country-Relative-Value
items.description: A systematic cross-country relative value strategy on government bond futures. We use ridge regression to forecast returns using economically-motivated features, and construct a relative value portfolio. The strategy is shown to be orthogonal to momentum, but residual returns are eroded by a naive execution strategy.

items.name: Meme-Agent
items.description: Meme-Agent is an automated trading and monitoring Agent for tokens on the Bsc blockchain. It is designed to discover, monitor, and trade tokens listed on a bonding curve contract, using growth and momentum-based strategies.ts through a companion SDK (Four_sdk) you developed using this agent.
